entities.summary: Flash Brown is the stage name of an American pornographic actor, model, and former professional basketball player. In his early adult career, he received both the Urban X Award for Best Male Newcomer and the XBIZ Awards for New Male Performer of the Year. In 2015, Brown became the first ever contract star for the adult interracial sex website Blacked. He later received the 2018 Urban X Award for Male Performer of the Year.
